limitations: Original author project, isolated media, exact fonts, masks and easing functions unavailable.
Every frame decoded and saved; visual interpretation uses overview, native anchors and selected dense mechanism windows, not a claim that all 6840 individual images were manually judged.

Historical and training claims are recorded as source content, not independently verified.
